Retrieve a previously created response

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let response_id = r#"resp-abc123"#;
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.retrieve_response(response_id).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.id);
    println!("{:?}", result.status);
}
```
